supporting_observations.claim: At 13:22 UTC, ruth.moss launched the Active Directory Users and Computers console on WS-RMOSS-01 and the console connected to DC-BLU-01 over RPC endpoint mapping and LDAP.
That activity is consistent with account-management work, but it does not establish that c.rwong was created, who created it, or whether its attributes and group membership followed policy.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-BLU-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:20 to 14:15 UTC, overlapping the reported account creation time; this leaves a major gap in the telemetry that could confirm the creator and account details.
The provided records contain no direct account-creation event or directory audit record for c.rwong.
claims_not_established: Whether c.rwong was actually created at approximately 13:42 UTC and which account performed the creation.
Whether c.rwong was added only to the Seasonal group and was not granted administrator rights.
Whether the account creation was authorized or associated with a legitimate request.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC-BLU-01 Security and directory audit events for the alert window, including account creation and group-membership changes, from an alternate or retained log source.
Check c.rwong's current and historical group memberships, privileges, creation metadata, and account status.
Verify the account request or change record with the help desk and confirm whether ruth.moss performed the activity.
unrelated_findings: WS-RMOSS-01 accessed slack.com and slack-edge.com through the proxy at about 14:12 UTC; this is separate from the account-management alert and is not used to determine its disposition (T188-00039, T188-00040, T188-00042, T188-00043).
